newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: L.Lease says Equitable unit talks ongoing.
newsitem.headline: L.Lease says Equitable unit talks ongoing.

text.p: Property and insurance group Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it was continuing negotiations with The Equitable Companies Inc of the United States over the possible acquisition of real estate manager, Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc (ERE).
"Negotiations are still going. We'd like for something to be finalised but basically no, it's (the negotiation) still ongoing," a Lend Lease spokeswoman for the company told Reuters.
The spokeswoman said Lend Lease could not say when the negotiations were likely to conclude.

Lend Lease first announced that it had entered talks with Equitable at the start of January. At that time the company said it did not expect to be in a position to make further comment before the end of February.
The company has said that if the deal was concluded, ERE would continue to manage the Equitable General Account real estate portfolio, which has a value of about US$5 billion.
ERE is the largest U.S. manager of real estate equity and mortgage investments on behalf of pension funds and other institutions, with about US$25 billion of funds under management.
